```yaml
name: Renovate Bot Migration

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight

jobs:
  github-actions-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Update GitHub Actions version
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=version::$(jq -r '.github.version' .github/workflow) + 1 | bc"

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions@github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update GitHub Actions version"
          git push origin main

  general-js-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Update JavaScript dependencies
        run: pnpm update

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions@github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update JavaScript dependencies"
          git push origin main
```
